header.running_head: Rasulullaah ﷺ is Particular about Dispatching the Army of Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA) even on his Deathbed, after which Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) also Gives the Same Importance to the Matter When he Becomes the Khalifah

blocks.text: Gives the Same Importance to the Matter When he Becomes the Khalifah
Rasulullaah ﷺ Dispatches the Army of Hadhrat Usaama (RA) which Included the Senior Sahabah (RA) and Rejects the Argument of those who Object to the Appointment of Hadhrat Usaama (RA)

Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ gave him instructions to attack the inhabitants of Ubna (in Palestine) at dawn and to raze their town to the ground. Rasulullaah ﷺ then said to him, "Proceed in the name of Allaah." Hadhrat Usaama (RA) then left flying the flag (that Rasulullaah ﷺ gave him) and handed it over to Hadhrat Burayda bin Husayb (RA) from the Banu Aslam tribe, who then carried it to the house of Hadhrat Usaama (RA). On the instruction of Rasulullaah ﷺ, the army of Hadhrat Usaama (RA) camped at a place called Jurf, which is today called Siqaaya Sulaymaan (close to Madinah). The soldiers then started to leave. Whoever had fulfilled his necessities would leave for his camp and whoever did not, would engage in completing it.
Every one of the earliest Muhaajireen were part of this expedition including Hadhrat Umar (RA), Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA), Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA), Hadhrat Abu A'war Sa'eed bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufayl (RA) and several others. Amongst the Ansaar who were part of the army were Hadhrat Qataadah bin Nu'maan (RA) and Hadhrat Salama bin Aslam bin Hareesh (RA).
Many of the Muhaajireen, Hadhrat Ayaash bin Abi Rabee'ah (RA) being the most vociferous of them, remarked, "This youth has been appointed as Ameer of the earliest Muhaajireen!" This talk then became rife. When Hadhrat Umar (RA) heard some of the talk, he refuted what the speaker said and then reported it to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ became extremely angry and although he had a bandage tied to his head (because of his illness) and was covered in a shawl, he left his room and ascended the pulpit. After praising Allaah, he said, "O people! What is this talk of yours that has reached me concerning the appointment of Usaama as Ameer? By Allaah! If you object to my appointing him as Ameer, you must have objected to my appointing his father (Hadhrat Zaid bin Haaritha (RA)) before him. I swear by Allaah that just as he was fit for leadership, his son after him is also fit for it. Just as his father was the most beloved person to me, he is the most beloved to me. They are both the most suitable people for any good. Accept my bequest to treat Usaama well for he is amongst the best of you." Rasulullaah ﷺ then descended from the pulpit and went to his room. This took place on Saturday 10th Rabee'ul Awwal.
The Muslims who were due to leave in the army of Hadhrat Usaama (RA) came to bid farewell to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Amongst them was Hadhrat Umar
